name: Sebastia Viscontip
original_name: セバスティア ヴィスコンティプ
source:
An Italian soldier who is very obedient and admires Italy's leader: she believes that her bad plans are actually pretty good and goes always along with her antics.

Her surname, Visconti, is also the family name of two important Italian noble dynasties of the Middle Ages.
